items.title: Osaka Public University — ~500 servers down, backups encrypted
items.summary: Ransomware reached the virtualization layer across all five campuses, taking nearly 500 servers offline and encrypting many backups; personal data of at least 130,000 students and alumni may be affected and classes were suspended into October 9.

items.title: DexCom (US medical devices) claimed by Redact
items.summary: The Redact group listed the $4.97B-revenue glucose-monitoring maker on its leak site on October 10; the claim is unconfirmed by the company.

items.title: Andersen Group hit by SilentRansomGroup
items.summary: The US professional-services firm was listed October 6 by SilentRansomGroup (a data-extortion crew known for callback phishing), with system disruption and a payment demand reported.

ransomware.note: Leak-site claims are unverified until victims confirm. SilentRansomGroup also posted two masked victims (Oct 5 and Oct 7). Bitdefender counted 790 claimed victims in September 2026, up 30% year over year.

items.title: Google Cloud europe-west2 (London) regional outage, ~5.5 hours
items.summary: A third-party tracker logged a regional incident beginning 08:35 UTC on October 20 affecting 12 services including Compute Engine, App Engine and Cloud Storage; confirm details against Google Cloud Service Health.

outage.note: Thin week: no confirmed major AWS or Azure outage found for October 2026. The most recent large AWS events remain the May 2026 Virginia thermal/power event and the Aug 20 partial outage.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day chained in attacks since Oct 1
items.summary: CISA told admins to patch immediately after Volexity found a threat actor chaining the flaw with two others since early October; the CVE number in coverage looks malformed, so verify against Ivanti's advisory and the KEV catalog.

items.title: CISA adds exploited Joomla extension zero-days to KEV
items.summary: CVE-2026-48939 and CVE-2026-56291, in the iCagenda and Balbooa Joomla extensions, were added to the catalog after active exploitation.

items.title: KEV pace: 247 additions YTD, most with 3-day deadlines
items.summary: Since BOD 26-04 replaced BOD 22-01 on June 10, 91 of 114 new KEV entries carry a three-day remediation window; Google GTIG reports an average of 11 exploited zero-days a month in Jan–Aug 2026, versus 8 in 2025.

items.title: M 7.0 earthquake — 191 km ENE of Nagqu, Tibet, China (Oct 22)
items.summary: USGS PAGER orange alert, signalling significant likely losses; no tsunami threat.

items.title: M 6.3 earthquake — 197 km NW of Port-Olry, Vanuatu (Oct 20)
items.summary: Offshore event flagged with a tsunami indicator; PAGER green alert.

items.title: M 5.7 earthquake — 48 km WNW of Khuzdar, Pakistan (Oct 17)
items.summary: PAGER yellow alert, meaning some damage is possible in Balochistan.

items.title: Hurricane Simon (Cat 4) strikes Mexico; Florida recovering from Isaias
items.summary: News listings from October 10–11 report a Category 4 Hurricane Simon off Mexico's coast and an earlier Category 2 landfall in Florida that left thousands without power; check NHC for official details.

items.title: Nebraska disaster declaration after record Omaha/Lincoln flooding
items.summary: A news digest dated Oct 2 reports a disaster declaration after record flooding in Omaha and Lincoln, alongside 99 flood warnings across the Midwest and Tropical Storm Choi-wan closing Saipan and Tinian.

physical.note: Tropical and flood items come from aggregator listings and have not been confirmed against NHC or FEMA primary sources. No October 2026 wildfire reporting was found.
